balance.lower_resist: Base resistance-reduction curve halved; 0.75% relative synergy per hard point, calculated as integer ratio 3/4 without truncating coefficient. All six resistance types retained.
balance.decrepify: Starts at 0%, adds 3 percentage points per second before 5% relative growth synergies, and caps at 90%. Cast radius grows with skill level. Progression applies to eligible targets on Hell.
balance.plague_infection: 10% poison damage per hard point, same sources; spread helper matches manual Infection.
balance.infection_death: 33% corpse base-life explosion, min=max; radius, half physical/fire split and guaranteed spread unchanged.
balance.attract: Flat physical damage per qualifying hit starts at 50 and gains 15 per additional level. The explosion starts at 60% of corpse base life and gains one radius unit per additional level. Confuse, Decrepify, and Infection each add 8% to both damage effects per hard point.
balance.elemental: All fire/cold/lightning base and level damage halved by reducing HitShift one bit; existing 15% synergies, 3-second fire cadence, cold duration/radius and lightning jumps retained.
balance.soul_harvest: Per soul, restore (1 + 0.3 * effective level)% Life and Mana before 3% relative healing per Confuse or Attract hard point. Add (0.5 + 0.08 * effective level)% maximum Life and Mana for 15 seconds per pickup.
